checks.label: manifest validation
checks.run: jq -e '.hooks | keys' hooks/hooks.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.name and .version' .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.plugins' .claude-plugin/marketplace.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.name and .version' .codex-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && jq -e '.plugins' .agents/plugins/marketplace.json >/dev/null

checks.label: plugin version agreement
checks.run: set -e; c=$(jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json); x=$(jq -r .version .codex-plugin/plugin.json); o=$(jq -r .version .opencode-plugin/package.json); [ "$c" = "$x" ] && [ "$c" = "$o" ] || { echo "version drift: .claude-plugin/plugin.json=$c .codex-plugin/plugin.json=$x .opencode-plugin/package.json=$o" >&2; exit 1; }

checks.label: typography
checks.run: export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; out=$(git grep -I -n -P '[—–‘’“”]' -- README.md docs/*.md docs/index.html .claude-plugin/marketplace.json); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 1; elif [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "typography check failed to run (git grep rc=$rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi

checks.label: opencode plugin
checks.run: cd .opencode-plugin && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test
